goal: Pick up the named target object from the table and lift it 10 cm.
success: The object labelled target has its root-origin z more than 0.10 m (strictly >0.1) above its z at the start of the episode (is_lift z_threshold=0.1). Only z of the root position is checked; no hold time, no xy condition, no gripper or arm-home condition.
evaluation: Checked after every action; the first step at which the target's root z exceeds its initial z by more than 0.10 m ends the episode with success (reward 1). There is no early-failure rule; the episode fails at step_lim=200 actions. The object only needs to reach that height at some step boundary (after an action finishes); it does not have to be held.
objects: target: 1 object chosen at random (unique) from about 80 categories with one fixed model each (e.g. bell, pepper, bicycle, binoculars, bottle, bottle_opener, bread, cactus, can, car, cassette, chick, clock, cup, donut, glasses, scissor, stapler, teddy_bear, watch, wrench, ... see config), on the table at x in [-0.4,0.4], y in [-0.2,0.05] (m), random yaw within +/-20 deg.
Clutter: 10 distractor objects (category_unique) on the table, x in [-0.45,0.45], y in [-0.2,0.05], random yaw +/-30 deg, margin 0.02 m. They are not referenced by the reward and may be in the way.
needs_memory_or_language: Language: the instruction names the target object; at runtime '<target>' is replaced with a natural-language description of the target's label (a random description from that label's description list, e.g. an object name or description). The agent must read which object is meant and distinguish it from the 10 clutter objects. The template text itself in the code contains the literal '<target>' placeholder.
notes: Lift is measured on the object's root origin z relative to its initial z (not on any grasp point), so any lift of 10 cm counts. Clutter objects can be mistaken for the target; the target identity is only given by the (substituted) instruction. Object categories vary a lot in shape and size (tools, toys, food), so grasp strategies must be generic.
